properties.note: Farm calibration area for the ground-PV detector, drawn by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --farmland: a cropland-weighted random cell from cropland stratum 7 of 8: 47.1%-60.0% cropland (cell), then a 3 km window inside it whose own cropland share (50.0%, ESA WorldCover) is within 25% of the cell's (50.4%). Map ALL solar inside, ground and rooftop, tracing the panels rather than the fence. Esri imagery here dates from 2025-05-05 (oldest of centre and corners), no older than 2025-04-01 for a composite starting 2026-04-01. Register with new_calibration_quadrat.py --farm.
